evals.name: fresh-machine
evals.prompt: configura o kit de skills de reel nessa máquina (roteiro, corte, animação e montagem), pra eu não ter que ficar dizendo onde tá cada coisa toda vez.
evals.setup: Private input, kept out of the repo: .scratch/setup-eusouosalmo-skills-workspace/setup.sh builds a miniature of the author's machine with light files only (home with the design system and the style file in the repo's scratch folder, the D: drive with the reels folder and the scripts of a notes vault, the C: drive with the CapCut projects folder and the author's drafts). Run with run.sh: claude -p from outside the repo, with the reel skills installed; the user is away.
evals.expected_output: The style file moved to the root of the reels folder with a symbolic link left at its old place, and a ## Paths block after its title naming the reels folder, the scripts folder in the vault, the design system, the CapCut projects folder and Jev-AI as reference project, every path existing; nothing written to ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md, a skill folder or the repo.
assertions: The reels folder's root has estilo.md with a '## Paths' block listing reels, scripts, design_system, capcut_drafts and capcut_reference_project, every path existing on the machine
The style file's old place is a symbolic link to the new one, and the rest of the file is unchanged
Nothing is written, or attempted, in ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md, in a skill folder or in the skills repository

evals.name: layperson
evals.prompt: acabei de instalar essas skills de vídeo, configura pra mim. nunca editei reel, meus vídeos ficam na pasta Vídeos do D:.
evals.setup: Private input, kept out of the repo: .scratch/setup-eusouosalmo-skills-workspace/setup.sh builds a miniature of the author's machine with light files only (home with the design system and the style file in the repo's scratch folder, the D: drive with the reels folder and the scripts of a notes vault, the C: drive with the CapCut projects folder and the author's drafts), then cases/layperson.sh leaves only the videos folder on D: with one reel folder of raw clips: no style file, design system, vault or CapCut. Run with run.sh: claude -p from outside the repo, with the reel skills installed; the user is away.
evals.expected_output: A new estilo.md at the root of the reels folder, holding a title and the ## Paths block, with the reels folder and none for the rest, and a message saying the skills work without the missing pieces; no global config.
assertions: The reels folder's root gets an estilo.md with a '## Paths' block naming the reels folder and none for every key that does not exist
Nothing is written, or attempted, in ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md or any other always-loaded file
The message to the user says the reel skills work without the missing pieces (defaults instead of a design system, mp4 without CapCut)
